{{Top|leg}}
An '''implant micro-motivator''' was a device invented by the [[Dargullan]] [[Dack]] in order to influence the outcomes of [[Umgullian blob]] races. By implanting the device into blobs, it triggered the creature's flight response, sending the blb to victory. Following the race, Dack would destroy the implant via remote detonation.
